title: Agent transfers funds, alters access or executes another irreversible external
bad_event: Agent transfers funds, alters access or executes another irreversible external action without consent
adversary: Untrusted agent with scenario-specific authority; full feasible action set requires specification.
refutation: A concrete executable trace produces the catalog bad event despite enforcing the candidate property: Typed transaction + exact signed approval from distinct principal, replay protection and spend/authority budgets
scope: Catalog-only draft. Origin: ControlArena SHADE Arena (illustrative real-world agent tasks). Feasibility estimate: H/M. Not a selected deployment.

assumptions.text: Complete reachable attacker actions and affected assets must be enumerated.
A trusted effect gate must enforce the relevant policy against every alternate path.
A frozen representative honest-task distribution and acceptance floor must be measured.
